task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/file.txt') and extract only the bucket name
solution_criteria: The regex must correctly match and capture bucket names from S3 URIs
The solution must handle S3 URIs with and without trailing paths

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS CloudWatch log event and extracts the timestamp and message fields
solution_criteria: The function must parse the CloudWatch event structure and return timestamp and message as separate values
The function should handle missing fields gracefully

task: Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that allows a user to read objects from a specific S3 bucket named 'audit-logs'
solution_criteria: The JSON must follow valid IAM policy structure with Effect, Action, and Resource fields
The policy must specifically allow s3:GetObject action on the 'audit-logs' bucket
